messages:
ivy_cs: Heads-up — Quarklytics onboarding is failing their CI runs with bursty 429s at cold start. They run 9 parallel matrix jobs; each job calls SDK init which triggers preflight + auth.

omar_eng: Can you paste the minimal request+response they see?

ivy_cs: Snippet from their GH Actions log: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer eph_xyz
...
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 5
{"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","context":"preflight_concurrency"}
```
Also occasional `401` when their ephemeral mint service rotates keys.

sasha_onboard: Pattern: each runner does fresh ephemeral mint + preflight -> multiplication of requests. They tried file-share earlier but want a more robust solution.

omar_eng: For customers with heavy matrix runs we sometimes recommend a token-broker pattern: a tiny single-step service in CI that mints one ephemeral token and serves it to runners over localhost or a single artifact. This avoids leader-election complexity and works nicely with ephemeral ephemeral-token TTLs.

ivy_cs: Can you sketch the simplest broker? Quarklytics prefers Node.

omar_eng: Example minimal broker (concept):
```
// token-broker.js (runs once per matrix job)
const express = require('express');
let token = null;
app.get('/token', (req,res)=>{
  if (!token || token.nearExpiry()) token = mint();
  res.json({token: token.value});
});
// start server, write URL to workspace for runners to read
```
Runners then call `curl http://localhost:PORT/token` (or read a workspace file with the URL) and reuse the same token for the job.

sasha_onboard: That's a clean pattern. Also recommend that runners respect `Retry-After` and implement small randomized delays on startup (200-1200ms) to avoid synchronized cold starts.

omar_eng: Also: if they can't run a local broker, they can use a tiny GitHub Action step that mints and uploads the token as an artifact for the matrix to download. But the broker is lower-latency.

greg_pm: Renewal risk: Quarklytics has a customer demo Friday; if CI is red we'll need to escalate. Flagged as medium-high. Set follow-ups.

ivy_cs: I shared the broker sketch and a backoff snippet. They implemented a broker in a single job step and staggered starts; 429s dropped from ~40% failures to ~2%. Remaining failures were two 401s during token rotation.

omar_eng: For the residual 401s: ensure the broker issues new token slightly before expiry and keep a small verification grace window on our side. If minting involves external IdP, add a 5-10s overlap.

sasha_onboard: I'll draft a short onboarding doc section titled "CI token broker pattern" with code samples and a GH Actions example.

ops-bot: Ticket CS-ONBOARD-3627 created for Quarklytics CI token-broker onboarding. Priority: high.

greg_pm: Action items: 1) sasha_onboard to publish doc + sample repo, 2) omar_eng to add note about verification grace window in the auth guide, 3) ivy_cs to verify 3 consecutive clean CI runs before closing.

ivy_cs: Customer reports 8 clean CI runs overnight. I'll close CS-ONBOARD-3627 after 48h of stability. Thanks team! :rocket:
